$comment: Parties and ledger users created by bootstrap.mjs. Each org party gets one least-privilege user (CanActAs + CanReadAs its own party, plus readAs extras). `participant` is used in 3-participant mode, `placements` (by participant count) in 5-participant mode; in 1-participant mode every party lives on `sandbox`. Party ids are generated by Canton and change on every sandbox start: read them from .local/localnet/state.json, never hard-code them.

placements.$comment: Participant of every party by participant count; overrides the `participant` fields. 5 = the privacy topology (docs/privacy-verification.md): registrar, governance and the seats on sandbox; the borrower, Lender A and Lender B each on their own participant; verifier, dealer and auditor together on a participant that hosts no borrower or lender.

dars.$extraComment: Uploaded in addition to the built DARs: DM governance-core-v1 provides GovernanceRules (daml-model.md section 1); it is not a build dependency of the contracts DAR.
